subject: Contract exception: ramp schedule & early-termination shielding
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acmecorp.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Contract exception: ramp schedule & early-termination shielding

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation, I pulled together the proposed ramp schedule and the early-termination clause language that Acme asked us to consider. Attached is a short addendum that: 1) introduces a three-month ramp with staged committed spend, and 2) includes an opt-out/early-termination carveout with limited downsell protection.

High level summary:
- Ramp: month 1 = 25% committed, month 2 = 60% committed, month 3 = 100% committed (as measured by billable compute units).
- Early-termination: customer can opt out after month 2 with 30 days notice; if they opt out before month 3 we propose a downsell protection credit equal to 20% of remaining committed fees for the third month only.

Can you confirm if this structure addresses Acme's flexibility needs? If you want tighter opt-out timelines or different credit math we can escalate for exec signoff — happy to do that if Procurement/Legal prefers a different tradeoff.

Next steps: if this looks close, I can send an updated SOW + addendum for countersignature and loop in DocuSign.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Acme_Ramp_Addendum_v2.docx

From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acmecorp.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acmecorp.com>, Acme Legal <legal@acmecorp.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract exception: ramp schedule & early-termination shielding

Karthik —

Thanks, appreciate the quick turnaround and the clarity on the ramp. A couple of items from Legal/Procurement:

1) Opt-out timing — Acme needs an option to opt out within the first 60 days with no more than a 30-day notice period. Our concern is structural: we may not know import volumes until after month 2.
2) Downsizing credit — 20% for month 3 is lower than we expected. If we have to opt out we want either (a) a pro-rata refund for unused committed capacity across the remainder of the ramp window, or (b) a higher credit (35%).
3) Limitations — Legal asked that any early-termination carveout be limited to non-malicious reasons (budget/prioritization) and not apply in cases of misuse/security events.

We can be flexible on committed numbers but Procurement asked that any deviation that worsens Redwood's take-rate be signed off by your leadership. Please escalate if you need an exception.

Jordan
Director, Platform Engineering
Acme Corporation

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: (internal)
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Contract exception: ramp schedule & early-termination shielding — request for exec signoff

Team —

Looping you in on Acme's ask. They want: a 60-day initial window to opt out with a 30-day notice and either pro-rata refund or ~35% credit if they downsize before month 3. Legal also wants the carveout scoped to non-security/non-abuse reasons.

Impact: attaching a quick pricing-impact analysis — worst-case incremental revenue headwind if we accept the pro-rata refund is ~18% on the first quarter of committed revenue; if we accept a 35% credit the impact is ~9%.

Ask: need leadership signoff to accept either:
A) Pro-rata refund for the remainder of the ramp window (preferred by Acme) OR
B) 35% one-time downsell credit (compromise) — this is what I'd recommend to protect revenue while giving the customer runway.

Constraints: any approval should specifically:
- limit the carveout to business reasons (budget/prioritization), exclude security/misuse;
- require Procurement countersignature AND DocuSign routing to Legal ops;
- be timeboxed to this deal only (no precedent): add "This clause applies only to Deal ACME-2247" in the addendum.

Attachments: pricing-impact-analysis-ACME.xlsx; Acme_Ramp_Addendum_v2.docx

Karthik

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Contract exception: ramp schedule & early-termination shielding — request for exec signoff

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear summary and the impact analysis. I approve option B (35% one-time downsell credit) with the following guardrails:

1) Scope the carveout strictly to non-security/business-priority downsizes. Add explicit language excluding termination for security incidents, fraud, or misuse.
2) Cap the credit to the remainder of the three-month ramp (i.e., credit applies only to month 3 committed fees). No refunds beyond the ramp window.
3) Require Procurement + Legal countersignature and a final check with Revenue Ops (Marissa) to ensure the credit is applied in billing correctly.
4) Add one-time 10% promotional credit (applied to month 1) in exchange for the limited downsell protection — this helps preserve revenue and shows good faith to the customer.

If Legal signs off on the exact wording, Marissa please confirm the booking flow and Laura confirm SOW language. Once all three confirm, Karthik please send revised addendum to Acme and route via DocuSign.

Vivek
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acmecorp.com>, Acme Legal <legal@acmecorp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 01 Aug 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract exception: ramp schedule & early-termination shielding

Jordan —

Appreciate the clarity on your team’s needs. Leadership approved a compromise we think balances flexibility and risk:

- If Acme opts out within the first 60 days with 30 days notice, Redwood will apply a one-time downsell credit equal to 35% of month 3 committed fees (credit does not apply beyond the three-month ramp).
- Carveout excludes termination for security/misuse/fraud.
- In addition, we’ll provide a one-time 10% promotional credit applied to month 1 to help offset initial ramp friction.
- All changes will be limited to Deal ACME-2247 and documented in an addendum; Legal/Procurement will need to countersign.

I’ve attached the revised addendum reflecting the language and the pricing-impact analysis for your review. Happy to hop on a short call if you want to walk through the wording. If this looks OK I’ll route via DocuSign once Legal confirms.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Acme_Ramp_Addendum_v2.docx, pricing-impact-analysis-ACME.xlsx
